summary: E-commerce app for Swapan Store selling Indian masalas, groceries, and food oils
known_issues: Products not displaying on the main Products page in the deployed application
Error encountered when attempting to view products on the deployed home page in Version 12
Admin navigation link is not visible in the header menu

Build a shopping cart page that displays added items with quantities, individual prices, total price, and options to update quantities or remove items

Display generated product images for masalas, groceries, and food oils as static assets in the product catalog

Create a search input field in the Header component that allows users to type product search queries

new_feature_requests.summary: E-commerce storefront for Indian masalas, groceries, and food oils
Create a product catalog system in the backend to store and manage products including Indian masalas, groceries, and food oils with fields for name, description, price, category, and image URL
Implement a shopping cart system in the backend that allows users to add products, update quantities, and retrieve cart contents

Populate the product catalog with sample data for at least 12 products across the three categories: Indian masalas (turmeric, cumin, garam masala, red chili powder), groceries (rice, lentils, flour, chickpeas), and food oils (mustard oil, coconut oil, sunflower oil, sesame oil)
Admin dashboard to manage products with ability to edit prices displayed in Indian Rupees (₹)
Implement a backend function to update product prices that accepts a product ID and new price value, validates the input, and persists the change to the product catalog
Add password authentication to admin dashboard access with password 'anugou9995'

Create a checkout page that collects customer address and phone number
Display customer orders with address and phone number in the admin dashboard
Show confirmation message to customer that product will be delivered today after checkout
Create an Order data type in the backend that stores customer phone number, delivery address, order items (product IDs and quantities), total price, order timestamp, and caller Principal
Implement a backend function to create and store orders that accepts phone number, address, and cart items, calculates total price, and persists the order with caller Principal and current timestamp
Add a backend query function to retrieve all orders for the admin dashboard that returns array of orders with customer details, items, and totals
Add ability to create new products in the admin dashboard

Automatically delete orders from dashboard that are older than 2 days (48 hours)

Add ability for consumers to remove individual products from the shopping cart

Update the Swapan Store brand logo in the header with a new logo image
Create a search bar component in the header that allows users to search for products by name
